analyst_view.overall: Lens (11th) and Toulouse (12th) are level on 13 points, but Lens come in after a 9-1 Champions League defeat at Como, two league defeats and the sacking of Yannick Cahuzac; Didier Digard, their third coach this season, takes charge for the first time after a week of training. Digard wants a pressing, front-foot side but says he will bring returning players back gradually: Ivanović is back from concussion, while Sima and Ganiou have only just resumed training and are likely on the bench at best. Édouard, Bulatović and Nawrocki are out and counted by the numbers; Mezian Mesloub may get a surprise start. Toulouse (Jens Berthel Askou) miss Messali (counted) and possibly Abu Francis, with Dønnum and Amougou back and Thomas Jørgensen doubtful. Referee Bastien Dechepy (4.4 cards a game) is already in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals, partly because Lens have leaked heavily lately. Sima, one of Lens' few fit forwards beside Thauvin and Hazard, is unlikely to start, which the numbers do not know, and a new coach after a 9-1 defeat will want a solid first game, so I trim slightly to about 2.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners. Lens are expected in a 3-4-2-1 with wing-backs and Digard wants play down the flanks, while Toulouse play a 4-4-2; that is close to how both usually play, so I stay at 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards and already add Dechepy's strict record (about +15%) and past meetings. A first game under a new coach brings energy but also more attention to discipline, and I found nothing that points either way, so I stay at 4.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.9 shots. Digard's pressing could add a few for Lens, but Toulouse create a lot without finishing and Lens' attack is short of fit forwards; these balance out, so I stay at 24.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 shots on target. With Sima likely on the bench at most and Édouard out (counted), Lens have less sharpness up front than the numbers allow for, so I trim slightly to about 8.6.
